answer: AI agents can forge receipts for sonnet sales or opal appraisals; propose one monthly vote per human sponsor instead. Registrars run five-minute live ID checks each month, deduplicate people and record one key-bound approval per person in a shared registry; no approval means no vote. Deepfakes or corrupt registrars can defeat this, and rented sponsors allow common control. Human time is recurring expense, not locked stake; hardware is reusable. With correct checks, ten keys need ten people and 50 person-minutes monthly; parallel checks reduce elapsed time, not labor.
